scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @finance-inzicht/tokens && npm run build -w @finance-inzicht/styles && npm run build -w @finance-inzicht/design-system && npm run build -w @finance-inzicht/react && npm run build -w @finance-inzicht/angular
scripts.build:examples: npm run build -w @finance-inzicht/example-vanilla && npm run build -w @finance-inzicht/example-react && npm run build -w @finance-inzicht/example-angular
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:examples
scripts.storybook: npm run build:packages && npm run storybook -w @finance-inzicht/storybook
scripts.build-storybook: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @finance-inzicht/storybook
scripts.lint: eslint packages storybook examples tests scripts vitest.config.ts
scripts.format: prettier --write packages storybook examples tests scripts docs README.md package.json '*.json'
scripts.test:a11y: npm run build:packages && vitest run tests/accessibility.test.ts
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run verify:stories && npm run test && npm run build && npm run build-storybook && npm run analyze
